t: Ruggedized Hard Cases: Armor for Equipment
title: Ruggedized Hard Cases: Armor for Equipment
description: Tactical ruggedized hard cases — Pelican, SKB, and their class — are roto-molded or injection-molded polymer shells that carry sensitive equipment through drops, water, dust, and stacking. Custom foam interiors cradle each item. The case is the difference between 'shipped' and 'arrived working.'
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Pelican Air and the Classics
description: Pelican's Air line cut case weight with HPX resin while keeping the crushproof, dustproof promise — the classic 1615/1650 sizes are the field standard. SKB's iSeries competes on the same terms. The category is mature; the differences are in latches, valves, and foam.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: IP67: Dust-Tight and Immersion-Proof
description: IP67 means dust-tight (6) and surviving 1m immersion for 30 minutes (7) — the sealing bar for field cases, via gasketed lids and purge valves. IP ratings are tested, not claimed. Water stays out or the rating is fiction.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: MIL-STD-810: The Test Regime
description: MIL-STD-810 is the environmental test regime — drop, vibration, shock, temperature, humidity, sand — that rugged cases get tested against. 'Designed to 810' means little; 'tested to 810 methods' with a report means everything. Procurement reads the test reports.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Custom Foam: The Cradle
description: Custom foam — CNC-cut polyethylene or polyurethane — holds each item in a fitted cavity so nothing moves, rattles, or point-loads in transit. Foam is designed around the equipment, not the case. Two layers (lid + base) is the standard build.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Pressure Equalization Valves
description: Automatic purge valves equalize case pressure across altitude and temperature changes while blocking water and dust — without one, a sealed case vacuum-locks or pops its gasket. The little valve is load-bearing engineering. GORE-style membranes do the breathing.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Latches, Hinges, and Handles
description: Double-throw latches stay shut under impact, stainless hinges survive the salt, and fold-down handles take the stacking load — the small hardware that decides whether the case works after the tenth deployment. Cheap hardware is the most expensive choice.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Rackmount Cases for Servers
description: Rackmount transit cases put 19-inch servers in shock-mounted frames inside the shell — edge-AI servers ride to the field in these. Shock mounts decouple the rack from the case so drops become gentle decelerations. Compute goes where the mission is.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Desert, Arctic, and Maritime Kits
description: Environment kits adapt cases: desiccant and dust filters for desert, insulation and heaters for arctic, corrosion protection for maritime. The case is the platform; the kit is the mission config. One shell, many climates.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: ATA 300: Airline Transport
description: ATA Specification 300 governs reusable airline transport containers — the category under which rugged cases fly as checked equipment. Cases that meet ATA 300 survive baggage handling repeatedly. The airline is an environmental test too.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Stacking and Palletizing
description: Cases stack and palletize with interlocking lids and documented stacking loads — logistics runs on the rectangle. Weight distribution and tie-down points are part of the design. The warehouse is part of the mission.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Security: Locks and Seals
description: Cases take padlocks, and seal hasps take the tamper-evident seals from the companion discipline — physical security rides with the equipment. Lock the case, seal the hasp, log the number. Transport security is layered.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Field Repair of Cases
description: Cases get repaired in the field — latch kits, valve replacements, foam re-cuts — because the case fleet is infrastructure. Repair beats replace on cost and on downtime. Maintain the armor.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

t: Sizing the Case to the Load
title: Sizing the Case to the Load
description: Case sizing starts from the equipment envelope plus foam plus handling clearances — too tight crushes connectors, too loose lets loads shift. The tape measure is the first design tool. Fit is protection.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: The Complete Transport Picture
description: Ladder-top cases: rated shell, fitted foam, sealed and valved, tested to 810, locked and sealed, stacked on pallets. Fifteen rungs from a plastic box to edge-AI servers arriving working in a desert.
provenance: Public record: compiled from official project documentation and published specifications. Fact-checked 2026-10-21.
